scope: New autonomous recipe: first obtain a matched settled C01 checkpoint, then activate constant full-height inlet/upstream-forcing FifthOrder waves with no ramp and no global wave initialization. This review performs no solver action.

evidence_read.historical_status: stopped_by_marker at1.605999999999934s; activation0, native period0.8472673206891129s, no ramp. This was not the new matched-settled-calm recipe.

prerequisites.source: Matched settled C01 checkpoint of exactly the wave mesh/domain/BC/numerical settings; preserve source SHA and actual time. This is separate from post-wave repeatability.
prerequisites.activation: Record actual absolute CFD activation time, full targetH, wavelength, inletplane, forcingzone, gaugecoordinates and no-ramp/no-reinitialize lineage.
prerequisites.period: Use native evaluated full-height wave period only after at least3consecutive finite runtime records with H at target and relative period variation≤1e−6. Freeze that period for cycle bins. Do not infer period from flat calm gauges, and do not use cached0/NaN at load.
prerequisites.gauges: Precreate actual/reference full-depth planes x=-1m and+2.5m. Verify planes do not intersect foil and area equals30m×0.02m. Both must be outside forcing/damping. Use same-station analytic references; retain raw absolute CFD times.
prerequisites.direction: Arrival policy assumes verified+x propagation/current and actual geometry. It does not substitute for head-wave direction/phase/reflection validation.

policy.sampling: Require finite paired actual/analytic samples at both stations, actual sample spacing≤min(0.02s,T/64), no gap>1.5×the configured sample interval, and full coverage of each cycle endpoint. Interpolate256points for comparison, while reporting real source sample counts; interpolation does not create resolution.
policy.cycle_bins: After period freeze, define complete candidate cycles [activation+kT,activation+(k+1)T]. Reject incomplete first/last cycles. Do not rephase a cycle to improve a comparison.
policy.conservative_time_floor: Let c_safe=min(abs(U),lambda/T), only for the verified positive-current positive-wave-direction case. Exclude candidate cycles whose start<activation+(x_downstream_gauge−x_inlet)/c_safe+T. This is a deliberate conservative time exclusion, not a model or proof of wave-envelope arrival.
policy.per_cycle_features: At each station and each complete cycle, compute mean eta, fundamental coefficients a=2/N Σ(eta−mean)cos(2πj/N), b=2/N Σ(eta−mean)sin(2πj/N), A1=hypot(a,b), phase=atan2(b,a), and residual waveform after subtracting mean. Compute the analytic A1 on the same samples/plane.
policy.signal_gate: At BOTH stations, require finite positive analytic A1 and actual A1≥max(0.5×analytic A1,0.10×H_target). Require the fundamental fit to explain≥70% of de-meaned actual variance. This establishes non-flat coherent wave signal only; half-reference amplitude is not wave-height acceptance.
policy.period_gate: Independently fit a sinusoidal frequency over the concatenated3candidate cycles; require fittedT within5% of frozen nativeT. A small fixed grid over0.85..1.15nativefrequency, refined around its optimum, is adequate; report boundary optima as failure. No phase alignment is permitted in waveform comparisons.
policy.three_cycle_gate: Require3consecutive complete cycles satisfying all signal/period conditions at BOTH stations, then compare all3pair combinations at each station with the formulas below.
policy.waveform_pair: 100*RMS((eta_i−mean_i)−(eta_j−mean_j))/max((Ai+Aj)/2,0.10*H_target)≤10%. Samples share fixed phase bins; do not phase-shift them.
policy.accept_arrival: On first pass, freeze analysis_origin_s at END of the THIRD qualifying cycle. Preserve excluded interval and qualifying cycle IDs/metrics. Do not count these startup-confirmation cycles as the4force-repeatability cycles.
policy.force_screen: Only subsequent complete cycles can enter the existing last4force-cycle all-pair screen: mean0.5%,amplitude2%,waveformRMS3%,phase2degrees with existing floors and no phase alignment. Four consecutive complete qualifying force cycles suffice;10is indicative, not a minimum.
policy.ongoing: Continue gauge checks. If wave signal/period/stability subsequently fails, withhold current repeatability admission and flag for review; do not silently slide origin forward or erase failures.
policy.hard_cap: Regardless of pending arrival, reach diagnostic review/stop at activation+20*T if the combined startup+force screen has not passed. Do not let a missing analysis_origin create an infinite loop. Report cycles since activation and since confirmed arrival separately.
policy.meaning: Arrival exclusion is operational and intentionally conservative. It is not amplitude accuracy, mesh/time independence, reflection validation, settled-cycle force accuracy or automatic final admission.

fail_closed: Missing/nonfinite gauges, native period, activation metadata, or target-height record.
Gauge plane intersects foil, incorrect area, forcing/damping overlap, or source identity mismatch.
Insufficient temporal sampling or an uncovered cycle interval.
Flat near-foil forces while gauges remain calm/prearrival.
Any existing physical/resource/time/source guard or unchanged0.01%inlet mass review condition requires its existing handling; no criterion is weakened here.

overhead.solver: Precreate and reuse the two actual and two analytic surface reports. Do not create reports, planes, scenes or full-field exports on each sample. Retain existing per-step physical/budget guards.
overhead.gauge_cadence: ForSO1ms,10-step gauge sampling is adequate forW01L20 and longer waves. ForL10 reduce to at most floor((T/64)/dt), typically≈7steps; choose5steps for a simple safe cadence. Use actual runtimeT. Do not retain all10oldgaugeplanes at the same high cadence if only2are needed for arrival; retain additional validation gauges at a separate justified cadence.
overhead.controller: Read gauge/force history for dashboard freshness every20–30wallseconds or incrementally; recompute cycle features only when a NEW complete cycle exists. Cache completed-cycle features and never repeatedly parse full histories for each dashboard widget.
overhead.figures: Update field images only on saved exports/checkpoints. Gauge arrival gating must not trigger expensive mesh/scene extraction.
overhead.cost_evidence: Record solver/report/output wall timings separately before attributing low GPU utilization to gauge reports; utilization alone is not a bottleneck diagnosis.

open_limits: Thresholds are explicit engineering heuristics for startup exclusion; no claim that these particular percentages are a Siemens validation standard.
Strong physical wave/foil scattering can make the two-station gate conservative and require human scientific review; do not auto-relax it.
The time floor uses mean-current-based conservative delay only after direction verification. For a different current/wave direction, the policy needs a different documented floor.
A near-foil pair cannot establish far-field reflection independence. Original reflection/domain/grid/time gates remain separate.

caller_responsibilities: Verify supplied period is native full-height and frozen
Persist earliest established origin in manifest
Enforce20T activation cap and all physical/mass guards
Only call force evaluator with persisted origin
This module only establishes arrival; ongoing wave validation remains separate
